Looking at adult only - by adult age¶

In [8]:
# trim off unused barcodes:
kuppe_metadata = kuppe_metadata[rownames(kuppe_metadata) %in% rownames(integrated_metadata),]

wang_metadata = wang_metadata[rownames(wang_metadata) %in% rownames(integrated_metadata),]

knightschrijver_metadata = knightschrijver_metadata[rownames(knightschrijver_metadata) %in% rownames(integrated_metadata),]
litvinukova_metadata = knightschrijver_metadata[knightschrijver_metadata$stage == "adult",]
In [ ]:
In [9]:
# standardise the "age" variable
kuppe_metadata$Age = gsub("-.*", "", kuppe_metadata$development_stage)
In [10]:
litvinukova_metadata$Age = as.numeric(gsub("-.*", "", litvinukova_metadata$age_group))+2.5
In [11]:
# add age in from the adult metadata sources
integrated_metadata$Age = 0
integrated_metadata[rownames(wang_metadata),"Age"] = wang_metadata$Age
integrated_metadata[rownames(kuppe_metadata),"Age"] = kuppe_metadata$Age
integrated_metadata[rownames(litvinukova_metadata),"Age"] = litvinukova_metadata$Age


# trim out aduly only:
integrated_metadata = integrated_metadata[integrated_metadata[,"Age"] != 0,]

pericytes only for examining core messages¶

In [30]:
ct_mask = pb_metadata$celltype == "Pericytes" & 
pb_metadata$stage == "adult" & 
pb_metadata$cell_or_nuclei == "nuclei" &
pb_metadata$dataset == "Kuppe2022" &
pb_metadata$donor != "P3"
In [31]:
x1_norm_pericytes = x1_norm[,ct_mask]
pb_metadata_pericytes = pb_metadata[ct_mask,]
In [32]:
# add unified age
pb_metadata_pericytes$Age = as.numeric(integrated_metadata[match(pb_metadata_pericytes$donor, integrated_metadata$donor),"Age"])
In [33]:

# PCA correlations with ECE1 expression in Pericytes
par(cex=1.5)
    plot(
        pericytes_PCA$x[,pc1], 
        colSums(x1_norm_pericytes["ECE1",,drop=F]), 
        pch=16, 
        col=plotcols(pb_metadata_pericytes$Age, alt.cols),
        xlab=paste("PC1:", signif(pca_eig[1,2],3), "%", sep=" "),
        ylab="ECE1 expression (log cp10K)"
    )
cor.test(pericytes_PCA$x[,pc1], colSums(x1_norm_pericytes["ECE1",,drop=F]))
gradient.legend(pb_metadata_pericytes$Age, colours = alt.cols, scale=0.75)
par(cex=1.5)
    plot(
        pericytes_PCA$x[,pc2], 
        colSums(x1_norm_pericytes["ECE1",,drop=F]), 
        pch=16, 
        col=plotcols(pb_metadata_pericytes$Age, alt.cols),
        xlab=paste("PC2:", signif(pca_eig[2,2],3), "%", sep=" "),
        ylab="ECE1 expression (log cp10K)"
    )
cor.test(pericytes_PCA$x[,pc2], colSums(x1_norm_pericytes["ECE1",,drop=F]))
gradient.legend(pb_metadata_pericytes$Age, colours = alt.cols, scale=0.75)
pdf("figures/pericyte_correlations_ECE1.pdf", width=20, height=10)
par(mfrow=c(1,2), mar=c(4,4,4,4), cex=3)

par(cex=3)
    plot(
        pericytes_PCA$x[,pc1], 
        colSums(x1_norm_pericytes["ECE1",,drop=F]), 
        pch=16, 
        col=plotcols(pb_metadata_pericytes$Age, alt.cols),
        xlab=paste("PC1:", signif(pca_eig[1,2],3), "%", sep=" "),
        ylab="ECE1 expression (log cp10K)"
    )
    r_sq = cor.test(pericytes_PCA$x[,pc1], colSums(x1_norm_pericytes["ECE1",,drop=F]))[[4]]
    p_val = cor.test(pericytes_PCA$x[,pc1], colSums(x1_norm_pericytes["ECE1",,drop=F]))[[3]]
    mtext(paste("pearsons r: ", signif(r_sq,3), ", p value: ", signif(p_val,3), sep=""), cex=2)
